items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: I didn't have Joe Stettick playing drums.

ctx.x: You asked me how big a band they used.

How big a band would you have? Well, we had, let me see, a left fella named Herman, Jim, Jim Kelly, I played, my son. He didn't have playing drums. I didn't have Joe Stettick playing drums. And then when I went away with the kids, with Wesley Don, he used to play my band then. And the rest of the time, Joe Roverson was a piano player, you know. And, uh, my father, I see him. It seemed to really get kind of a band that time. They had a dance that called the 49 dance. It was three bands, you see. We played an hour…
Raggedy as a pukorn. Yeah. Yeah.
